name: Summer Camp at RNC
description_short: Weekly nature day camp in the Rye Nature Center's 47 acre forest for children from age 3 and a half through grade 7. Groups hike, study natural history, do art and STEM projects and visit the center's animals, with a project showcase for families each Friday.

fees.name: Membership
fees.note: Friends of Rye Nature Center, Environmentalist level or higher, valid through the camp dates; one per family

refund_policy_summary: Changing dates costs a $50 fee if space allows; there are no refunds or credits if you cancel (the fee can be turned into a tax deductible donation). Membership is non-refundable.
notes: An Environmentalist level membership ($125 or higher) is required to attend, one per family, so there is no non-member rate. Groups: Explorers (entering Pre-K or K, at least 3.5 years old and toilet trained) mornings 9 to 12 or afternoons 1 to 4, $475 a week; Discoverers (entering K to grade 5) 9 to 3, $510 a week; Naturalists in Training (entering grades 6 to 7) 9 to 3 with a Thursday cookout until 5:30, $525 a week. Week 1 is four days (no camp July 3). Session prices shown are for Discoverers. Need based aid through the Nature Access Fund, apply by May 1.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp page, 2026 season (registration opened January 28, 2026; 2026 Camp Guide): eight weeks June 29 to August 21.
